capture.coverage: Native v2 session_start, message IDs/parent links, timestamps and tool outcomes verified against owned authenticated Droid 1.6.0 initial and resumed writer captures. Public SessionStore imports after each turn retain previous IDs and remain idempotent on repeat capture. Explicit llm_only/user_only and hook context stays metadata. Legacy/project roots, coherent sidecars, unsupported versions and duplicate identities are covered.

Authenticated Droid 1.6.0 Read success/error and a second same-session Read verify native tool_use IDs joining tool_result tool_use_id and explicit is_error fidelity. Native marker links, envelope provenance and bounded tool/block metadata are retained, including non-text shapes covered synthetically; mixed human text stays distinct from tool output. Session settings and cumulative counters stay metadata; no inferred per-message usage, credits-to-token conversion, file edits or relationships.

Passive bounded head/tail discovery, selected hydration, full and scoped watch sweeps, resumed appends, deferred partial final records, full rewrites and sidecar-only updates; per-file read failures preserve the previous snapshot without blocking healthy sessions. Full transcript snapshots are limited to 128 MiB and settings to 1 MiB, with diagnostics and no retirement on failure. No agent launch or network request during acquisition.
